description: The builder on desktop (WP-36, BLD-020 to BLD-049; the hub signs the updater file, R-116): this computer's builder token in the key store, the tool check, and the fixed build steps: check out a commit, run the gates, bundle a target at a version, list the job's files with their digests and upload one to the presigned URL the hub gave, cancel. No step takes a program, a path or an argument list. Main web view only.
